title: Jacques Vallée co-opted in the 1980s

tellings.quote: because in the 80s he got taken in by that organization.

plain: In the 1980s the well-known UFO researcher Jacques Vallée "got taken in" by a secret organization that controls UFO knowledge, according to the UFO activist Steven Greer, who tells Michels this without naming a source or saying more about the organization. If true, it would mean one of the field's leading independent voices was steered by the very group Greer says keeps the secrets.
